name: vitess.io/vitess/go/vt/sqlparser
license_evidence: LICENSE in the pinned module zip (SHA-256 cfc7749b96f63bd31c3c42b5c471bf756814053e847c10f3eb003417bc523d30, Apache License 2.0)
input_api: sqlparser.New(sqlparser.Options{}); Parser.SplitStatementToPieces and Parser.Parse(local SQL text) -> Statement
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes, split and parsed with the default MySQL version; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls, each equal to the hand-written oracle summary. Other server versions and vitess-only syntax are untested.
family: vitess MySQL grammar (goyacc sql.y) and tokenizer
family_note: Parser.Parse runs vitess's own tokenizer (token.go) and the goyacc parser generated from sql.y; Go coverage reports the generated parser through its sql.y and yaccpar line directives. The adapter reads *Select (SelectExprs, From join tree, Where, GroupBy, OrderBy) and *Insert (Table, Columns, Values) and walks the tree with sqlparser.Walk for AliasedTableExpr base tables, AggrFunc/FuncExpr names and Literal values. xwb1989/sqlparser and blastrain/vitess-sqlparser are extracted forks of older vitess sqlparser versions (shared family).

popularity.limitation: Importer count of this package path; forks and vendored copies are counted separately.
